description: The Kerkje aan de Zee is a brick church with round-arch windows and a square tower on the high ground of the former island. The crown is the 1955 balustrade, octagonal lantern, and onion spire. It is overcast, about 14.1°C. The church is closed. The white lighthouse and the fishing basin are not in this frame.
